name: Video Summarizer
headline: Video Summarizer: Download & Summarize 1800+
short_description: Download videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Twitter/X and 1800+ platforms. Outputs MP4, MP3, subtitles, transcript and AI summary - Claude Code skill
author: liang121

sections.overview:
Video Summarizer is a Claude Code skill that downloads videos from over 1800 platforms—including YouTube, Bilibili, Twitter/X, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, and Vimeo—and automatically extracts key information. The skill uses faster-whisper for parallel transcription (4-5x faster than standard processing) and generates structured AI-powered summaries with timestamps and key points. It outputs complete resource packages including video (MP4), audio (MP3), subtitles (VTT), plain-text transcripts, and markdown summaries. Dependencies like yt-dlp and ffmpeg are auto-installed, making it accessible for users who need to quickly digest video content without manual setup.
Transcribe and summarize YouTube videos for research or note-taking
Extract audio and subtitles from Bilibili content
Convert Twitter/X video threads to text transcripts
Batch process multiple videos to generate markdown summaries
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/liang121/video-summarizer`
sections.usage:
```
Download the video titled '[VIDEO_TITLE]' from [PLATFORM] and generate a summary. Extract the transcript, subtitles, and save the audio as an MP3 file. Provide a concise AI summary of the key points in bullet form.
```
Copy

```
# Video Summary: 'The Future of Renewable Energy'
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
